candidates.description: Presence or absence of the KRAS G12C mutation in the tumor tissue.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Identify if the radiology or pathology reports mention 'KRAS G12C-mutated' or 'KRAS G12C mutation'.
candidates.measurement_definition: Positive: Explicitly documented as 'KRAS G12C-mutated'. Negative: Explicitly documented as KRAS wild-type or absence of the G12C mutation. Absence of mention is not a negative measurement.
candidates.name: KRAS G12C Mutation Status
candidates.uncertainty: The evidence does not specify the assay method (e.g., NGS vs IHC) used to determine mutation status.

candidates.description: The percentage of tumor cells expressing Programmed Death-Ligand 1 (PD-L1).
candidates.extraction_instruction: Extract the percentage value associated with 'PD-L1' (e.g., 'PD-L1 10 %').
candidates.name: PD-L1 Expression
candidates.uncertainty: It is unclear whether the percentage refers to total tumor cell staining (TPS) or a different scoring system.

limitations: Small number of patients provided in the evidence snippets.
Lack of detailed information on the specific diagnostic assays used for molecular markers.
Limited variation in the PD-L1 values provided (only 5% and 10% are mentioned).
summary: The retrieval evidence identifies molecular profiling characteristics in patients with non-small cell lung adenocarcinoma (NSCLC), specifically focusing on KRAS G12C mutation status and PD-L1 expression levels as key baseline clinical variables.
